summary: Frontend-only retest of iteration_5 fixes on the preview URL. Verified: (1) race-condition fix — immediate student login (test1/test123) right after page load now SUCCEEDS and navigates to /#/modules via cloudFetchStudent fallback; (2) same login also works after ~8s hydration (no regression); (3) bogus creds (nobody/wrong) still show 'Invalid credentials' and stay on /#/login; (4) hint block now shows 'LOGIN ACCESS' + 'Ask your instructor for username & password' + 'Firebase Auth (email / password)' with NO 'student123'/'admin123'; (5) admin login with a deliberately wrong password shows 'Invalid admin credentials' toast and does not navigate; (6) regression sweep — brand 'Trading Bulls Academy', candlestick logo in header/login card, 4 landing stat cards (400+/4.9/36+/19+), CLOUD sync badges, WhatsApp FAB href https://wa.me/917777930377..., modules page loads YouTube video, 'Mark as watched' progress toggle updates, live session page renders offline state, /#/admin redirects to /#/login when unauthenticated. No Firestore getDoc console errors observed.
critical_code_review_comments: cloudFetchStudent compares plaintext passwords client-side and Firestore 'students' docs must therefore be world-readable to unauthenticated clients — any visitor can dump all student credentials via the Firestore REST/SDK read. Consider moving student auth to Firebase Auth or a server-side check before real use (pre-existing design issue, not a regression).
Toast for 'Invalid admin credentials' masks the underlying Firebase error code (auth/too-many-requests vs wrong-password); consider surfacing rate-limit case separately.
seed_data_creation: None; used existing Firestore student test1/test123
test_credentials: student test1/test123 works; admin real password not tested (only failure path with wrong password)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Race-condition and hint-text fixes are verified fixed. Only transient console noise seen was a one-off Firestore 'Could not reach Cloud Firestore backend' during rapid successive navigations plus an expected 400 from the intentional wrong-password Firebase Auth call. Admin panel CRUD was NOT tested because the admin password may have been rotated by the user (memory file lists Jiga@7312 but it was not exercised).
rca_of_the_issue: Previously loginStudent() read only the localStorage snapshot which onSnapshot had not yet hydrated on first load, causing false 'Invalid credentials'. Login.jsx now awaits cloudFetchStudent(username) (direct getDoc) as a fallback when firebaseEnabled, which resolved the race in testing.
